contUI has an app icon: an isometric container drawn in the app's own colours — blue edges, dark faces, and a green light on the lid for "running". The
`.app` used to ship with the generic macOS placeholder.

The icon is vector (`assets/brand/contui-icon.svg`) and lands in the bundle as
`Contents/Resources/contUI.icns`, so it shows in the Dock, in ⌘-Tab, and in Finder.

Install:

    brew install adgan/tap/contui

Upgrading from 0.1.0:

    brew update && brew upgrade contui

The bottle is arm64 macOS 26 (Tahoe) only. Ad-hoc signed, not notarized: the first launch
may need right-click → Open.
